# packages/api-client — GENERATED API client

Generated by [hey-api openapi-ts](https://heyapi.dev) from `openapi.json`, which is exported
from the FastAPI app. Consumed by `packages/core` (and type imports in apps).

## Never edit generated files

`src/gen/**` and `openapi.json` are overwritten by codegen. To change anything in them, change
the backend (`apps/api`) and regenerate:

```bash
pnpm codegen      # from repo root: export schema (uv) + generate + format
```

CI regenerates and fails if the committed output differs.

## Hand-written files (the only ones you may edit)

- `openapi-ts.config.ts` — plugins: typescript, client-axios, sdk, zod, @tanstack/react-query.
- `src/runtime-config.ts` — defaults for the generated client (`throwOnError: true`, timeout).
- `src/configure.ts` — `configureApiClient({ baseURL, tokens })`: bearer header + single-flight
  refresh on 401 (retries the original request once); `getApiError`, `getFieldErrors`.
- `src/index.ts` — public exports.

## Entry points

| Import                        | Contents                                                                                             |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `@workspace/api-client`       | SDK functions (`listTodos`…), all types (`TodoRead`…), `client`, `configureApiClient`, error helpers |
| `@workspace/api-client/zod`   | Zod schemas (`zTodoCreate`, `zUserCreate`…) with backend constraints                                 |
| `@workspace/api-client/query` | React Query helpers: `<op>Options`, `<op>QueryKey`, `<op>InfiniteOptions`, `<op>Mutation`            |

Naming comes from the backend handler name (operationId): `list_todos` → `listTodos`.
`baseURL` must be the API **origin** (paths include `/api/v1`).
